summary: Opus review of the L2 diff (docs/plans/2026-10-25-L2-review.md: 2 Important, 8 Minor). Fixed: a TERM mid-init stops the init before the teardown; a TERM mid-teardown waits for it, no second; .harness/teardown.sh looked up at each stop point, not at load_config; the trap commits its note; template runnable by hand; docs. 4 new checks RED→GREEN.

discoveries.text: Deferred L2 review Minors: two projects' runs of one id share harness-<id>-svc (refuse in cmd_start); SVC_UP is shell-only, so a continue segment with no init leaves a SIGKILLed segment's svc scope to gc ($STATE/svc-up sketch); without user systemd the note says services stopped while bare init children run on.

The suite project's INIT_CMD now takes STUB_SLOW_INITCMD=<s> (touches $HARNESS_SCRATCH/init-begin, sleeps) and its teardown.sh STUB_SLOW_TEARDOWN=<s> (touches teardown-begin); stub-claude STUB_ADD_TEARDOWN=1 makes the initializer write an executable .harness/teardown.sh. tests/run.sh has sd_before <key> <index>.
TEARDOWN_CMD defaults to empty now; services_down picks .harness/teardown.sh when executable at call time.
The known 'queue holds an entry whose project has a live run' flake (busy3 sleep 3) failed once more in a KEEP=1 run under load.
